sub_palette: near_eastern (egyptian) backbone + east_asian (sinitic) overlay (cross-family blend, Egyptian-leaning)

blend.backbone: near_eastern (egyptian: the per-netjer river-temples, the nesut/per-aa god-king register, the dj/tj/kh phonology and -aa/-et endings, construct-chain toponyms Per-/Niut-/Ta-, the funerary-cult and Nile-flood ideology, VSO with triconsonantal roots)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the cheng walled-cities, the Confucian scribal mandarinate, the celestial court and Mandate of Heaven, monosyllabic river/silk/jade/tea material vocabulary, the warlord-province administration)
blend.lean: Egyptian-heavy - a Nile-temple god-kingship enthroned over a Sinitic scribal-bureaucratic civilization: the per-aa and his temple-priesthood crown the realm, the mandarin court and walled river-cities administer it beneath. The dragon serves the sun-disc; the celestial bureau keeps the god-king's ledgers.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_05 (Egyptian / Abydosian) x BASE_09 (Sinitic / Jinxian). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Egyptian base = Civilized, Sinitic base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Longkem is Civilized (feudal). Concept: an Egypto-Sinitic realm - the dragon and the sun-disc fused. A Nile-style god-kingship of river-temples and hieroglyphic scribes married to a Sinitic celestial court of walled cities and a mandarin bureaucracy. Backbone = Egyptian (the ruling temple/god-king register, the per-netjer river-temples, the nesut/per-aa titles, construct-chain toponyms, the dj/tj/kh phonology); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the cheng cities, the silk-and-jade material economy, the Confucian-style scribal mandarinate, the river/canal bureaucracy). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Egyptian and Chinese registers fused (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Egyptian reflexes PRIMARY via abydosian, Sinitic morphs SECONDARY via family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic / jinxian), never real Egyptian/Chinese gods. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term: 'Pharaoh' at the kingdom tier); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. APPROVED FOREIGN TERM: kingdom display = 'Pharaoh' (the commonly-known Egyptian term, set in 'ruler').

phonology.palette: Egyptian (Afro-Asiatic) backbone - dj, tj, kh, h, sh, q; l tends to r; v tends to w; long -aa and -et endings; triconsonantal stems; VSO clause order; theophoric on morphed canon-stems (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-, Riaret-) - meeting a Sinitic overlay: monosyllabic morphemes, the celestial -di/-jun/-wang court titles, the cheng/jiang/shan toponyms. Per the CSV: tonal contours flattened onto triconsonantal roots; Sinitic monosyllables fitted to Egyptian root-patterns and re-vowelled to -aa/-et; sharp -n/-ng Sinitic codas softened toward the Egyptian inventory; heavy temple/Nile register dominant, Sinitic material-and-river words substrated beneath. Theophoric on the Egyptian reflexes (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-) with Sinitic celestial-court variants (Tuli-di, Lianta-mu).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; Egyptian clusters dj/tj/kh and long -aa; Sinitic monosyllables re-shaped to triconsonantal roots and given -aa/-et; -n/-ng Sinitic codas retained only where they sit easily on the Egyptian frame; VSO order; construct-chain Per-/Niut-/Ta- toponyms over Sinitic feature-roots.

sound_changes: Sinitic tones dropped entirely; the bare monosyllable kept as a consonant-vowel skeleton

Sinitic isolating monosyllables fitted to Egyptian triconsonantal roots: a thin root gains a dj/tj/kh onset or an Egyptian medial, and is re-vowelled to the Egyptian set (Sinitic -ang/-eng/-uan re-formed toward -aa/-et, e.g. jiang>djara, sheng>tjaret)
Egyptian l>r and v>w applied to every borrowed root; Egyptian dj/tj/kh flavor imposed on the onset where a root would otherwise be too plain
Sinitic -n/-ng codas kept only where they fall easily on the Egyptian frame; otherwise resolved to a vowel or an Egyptian coda; very short roots take a long -aa or feminine -et
clause/name order is Egyptian VSO with the construct chain (Per-/Niut-/Ta-/Pa-); Egyptian root-initial weight, no Sinitic tones surviving
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/canal/silk/jade/tea/material/market/bureaucratic words from Sinitic roots (the scribal-mercantile substrate keeps its river-and-trade vocabulary); rule/kin-line/temple/Nile/land/quality/abstract/war words from Egyptian roots (the god-king and temple register); every chosen root then run through the one Egyptian-shaped sound-law so the seam is invisible
portmanteaus: son sa+zi>sadji (the god-king's get; the heir-blood)

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/material/bureaucratic roots + Egyptian rule/kin/temple/Nile roots, all run through one Egyptian-shaped sound-law (tones dropped, monosyllables fitted to triconsonantal roots and re-vowelled to -aa/-et, l>r, v>w, dj/tj/kh flavor, VSO); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. No slashes - one word per concept.

toponymic_suffixes: -djara (river; from Sinitic jiang on the Egyptian frame)
morphology.patronymic_form: the Egyptian ruling temple-house keeps filiation 'sa' (son-of) and theophoric construct given-names with no inherited surname; the Sinitic scribal mandarinate keeps the surname-first (xing) clan-name and lineage (zu/zong); the throne fuses both - a nesut who carries a Per- temple-house and a Sinitic court-surname beneath.
morphology.compounding_rule: Egyptian construct chains (Per-[god], Niut-[feature], Ta-[land], Pa-[noun]) layered over Sinitic quality+type compounds re-shaped to the Egyptian frame: the capital Longkem (the dragon-of-the-black-land), Per-Tjuraa (temple-city of the sun), Niutjeng-Aat (the great walled river-city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Egyptian god-king temple-state over a Sinitic celestial-court bureaucracy: the per-aa and the nesut at the crown with the temple-priesthood, the heqa-aa princes and sepati nomarchs administering through the Sinitic mandarinate of dudu-governors and scribal officials; the per-netjer river-temples and the celestial bureau order all beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Egyptian ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic celestial-court co-titles fused beneath. Hatia-nan (mayor + Sinitic baron) barony; Wer-dudu (great-one of the frontier-land + Sinitic frontier-commander) march; Sepati-bo (nomarch + Sinitic count) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut-wang (king + Sinitic wang) kingdom - DISPLAYED as 'Pharaoh', the commonly-known term, over a Nesutat; Per-aa-di (the Great House + Sinitic huangdi-emperor) empire over the Per-aat-guo. The Sinitic mandarinate (the dudu-governors, the scribal officials) administers the nomes beneath the Egyptian temple-crown. The hem-netjer priesthood and the daoshi ritual-masters stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Egyptian and Chinese registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince; Egyptian); the Taizi (Sinitic crown prince) beneath
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here 'Pharaoh' at the kingdom tier). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Egyptian ruling temple-stock carry a theophoric given + filiation (sa-X) and an earned epithet, no inherited surname; the Sinitic scribal mandarinate carry a clan-surname (xing) first + given name; the throne fuses both - a theophoric given under a Per- temple-house with a court-surname; order given-first for the Egyptian register, family-first for the Sinitic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Egyptian temple-aristocracy keep theophoric god-king names (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-, Mery-, Sa-) on the morphed canon-stems; the Sinitic mandarinate keep xing + ming with a courtesy-name (zi) and sobriquet (hao) for the learned.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names built from the morphed deity-names + an Egyptian element (X-hotep, X-mose, Mery-X, Sa-X) for the temple-stock; the Sinitic officials invoke the celestial powers' epithets and virtues rather than the god-name directly (Tian-en = heaven's grace; a temple-name honoring Tuli-di). e.g. Tjuraa-hotep, Mery-Djeroraa; Li Zhongyan (the scribal register).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Egyptian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern egyptian sub-palette, the abydosian column: phoneme-morphs through Egyptian phonology, l>r, v>w, -us/-a>-aa/-et, dj/tj/kh flavor), Sinitic celestial-court variants SECONDARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic, the jinxian column: the -di/-jun/-mu celestial bureau) - never real Egyptian/Chinese gods. The two are named as one power under two faces: the sun-disc of the river-temple and the celestial emperor of the bureau are the same god. Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; a god-king funerary cult fused with a Mandate-of-Heaven celestial bureaucracy.
religion.the_one: Atjernaa (Egyptian; < Aeternus; Sinitic Aiteng) - the hidden distant maker and Highest Heaven, source of the Mandate, honored not petitioned

Tulrius.gloss: the sun-disc and right-order; the Sun-Justice Emperor of the celestial bureau

Delorum.gloss: lord of the peaceful dead, the funerary judge

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring earth and the river-flood, lord of mountains and grain

Numeno.gloss: sky-wisdom and the scribal arts, the Sage Lord of winds

Realta.gloss: the mother, mercy, the Mother of Mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atjernaa the Highest Heaven, Tjuraa the just sun-disc (Tuli-di of the celestial bureau), Gauandj of the river-flood, Riaret the merciful - ordered by the funerary rites of the per-netjer and the Confucian celestial ritual alike; names the Chaotic powers the Hefau-kin (the serpent-brood) and the demon-marshals (mo), warded
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified god-kings and akhu (the justified dead) of the ruling temple-house and the ancestral zu of the mandarin clans (honored at the Ci shrine and the tomb-temple); the great powers and the local earth-and-grain and river-spirits invoked at the per-netjer and the miao situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the Hefau-kin and the demon-marshals - and names the Lawful powers, and Atjernaa, as the tyrant-gods of the throne and the bureau to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the Hefau-kin (the great-serpent brood; Egyptian) or the demon-marshals (mo; Sinitic), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhu the City-Burner (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devouring Hefau (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusandj the Hoard-Serpent (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/river-temple) of [power]: 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'; the celestial Miao (temple) of the same power for the bureau: 'the Miao of Tuli-di'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified god-kings and akhu (the justified dead; maa-kheru) venerated at the tomb-temples, and the worthy officials and deified heroes enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: a sun-disc above the feather of right-order, coiled by the river-dragon
holy_symbol_motifs.Djeroraa: the crook and flail over a tomb-pylon and the celestial seal
holy_symbol_motifs.Gauandj: the alluvial flood-field beneath the dragon and the grain-altar
